build_origin: publish-windows-release.yml on windows-latest builds the MSI from source_commit; it refuses to run if desktop/, app/src/main, native/ or docs/licenses changed since

windows_ci.steps: desktop tests, MSI packaging, silent install, Ketvoice.exe --smoke (ONNX Runtime, LGPL FFmpeg, SMTC DLL), uninstall

android_ci_shared_code.note: shared app sources the desktop compiles

ui_text_audit: tools/audit_ui_texts.py --check: 0 unaccounted; all new desktop strings carry 10 translations
license_check: checkNoGpl: no -gpl artifact in the runtime; FFmpeg is the JavaCPP LGPL v3 build; notices installed under app/resources/licenses

credential_scan.scope: desktop distributable built from source_commit (createDistributable, 203 files/archive entries, incl. the bundled Java runtime)

reviewed_false_positives.reason: OpenJDK's java.util.LocaleISOData ISO-3166 country-code table, a run of capital letters; not a credential

models.ketmix-stems-onnx-v1: published 2026-11-21 as a prerelease, not latest; assets match tools/stems/expected-onnx.sha256
models.beat_model: downloaded on request from ketmix-beat-v1's pinned source with SHA-256 c462b064…aea

release_policy.reason: the Android in-app updater and the website read the latest release (v8.0.0)

publication_override.user_statement: J'autorise TOUT devient maintenant une règle.
publication_override.owner_request: « Quand tu auras fini ça fait la version la première 1.0.0 Windows de Ketvoice » (2026-11-20)
publication_override.reason: The owner made publishing validated versions without device testing a standing rule.
publication_override.scope: installation and use on the owner's own Windows computer

not_validated: No person has installed or used the app on a real Windows PC; only the GitHub windows-latest runner installed it silently, ran --smoke and uninstalled it.
No sound was heard on a real Windows sound card (playback, gapless, Ketmix mixes, voice level, equalizer).
Sign-in, library sync and Discord sign-in against the live Supabase were not tried; Discord needs the loopback redirect URLs added by the owner.
Phone control between two real devices over Supabase Realtime was not tried; the phone side ships only with the next Android version.
Live catalogue search, streaming, downloads, lyrics sources, Canvas downloads and playlist imports were not tried from Windows (host tests never reach the network).
The in-app updater has never upgraded a real installation (tested with a fake release feed).
The MSI is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen will warn about an unknown publisher.
The mini-player window, focus behaviour, file associations and Start-menu shortcut were not checked by a person.
Separation quality on real songs was not measured on Windows.
known_limitations: Library pre-separation and streaming separation ahead of the playhead are not ported to Windows.
Ketmix bar loop and the Ketmix Studio editor are not on Windows yet.
The phone is only reachable for phone control while its app is open or playing.
